findings.problem: The Ollama fetch does not reject HTTP redirects. A 307 or 308 response from the fixed loopback endpoint can redirect the material-bearing POST elsewhere, so the fixed initial URL alone does not enforce the stated local-only network boundary.
findings.recommendedChange: Set redirect to error on every Ollama request and add a no-inference regression that rejects a redirect response. Keep model and endpoint selection controlled by the backend.
findings.scope: This is an enforced-boundary gap. No external request or private-material egress was executed during review.

resolution.evidence: All Ollama requests use the one helper with redirect:error. The no-inference transport regression asserts this option for tags, show, and chat and verifies a failed model request cannot become rule success.
resolution.independentTest: Ollama calls reject redirects and a model transport failure cannot become rule success

findings.problem: The job finally block awaits rm before resolveDone. If cleanup rejects, the done promise is never resolved and processing is never reset; void drain is also left with an unhandled rejection. DELETE can await job.done indefinitely and close can loop while processing stays true.
findings.recommendedChange: Guarantee resolveDone in an inner finally and processing reset in an outer finally. Capture cleanup failure, surface an explicit sanitized failure or retry cleanup, and handle the drain promise. Add fault-injection coverage for rm rejection.
findings.scope: The cleanup-error branch was identified statically. No filesystem permission failure was injected during this review.

resolution.evidence: removeDirectory catches rm failures and retains a pending cleanup entry; job.done is resolved and processing is reset by finalization. Cleanup failures suppress results, produce TEMP_CLEANUP_FAILED, remain visible in health, and DELETE returns 503 until a cleanup retry succeeds. Background retries and close root cleanup are explicit; close clears in-memory cached material.
resolution.independentTest: temporary cleanup failures remain visible without hanging cancellation or the next job; an occupied listen port removes the newly created private service directory

findings.problem: The production extraction prompt declares every input to be a synthetic document even though the upload service can receive genuine documents. This injects an unsupported assumption into the model's interpretation of the evidence.
findings.recommendedChange: Remove the blanket synthetic-document statement. Preserve the candidate-fact and human-review instructions. Mark a synthetic fixture in evidence records only when its origin is actually known.

resolution.evidence: The unsupported synthetic-document declaration is removed. The prompt retains exact quotations, supplied IDs, candidate facts, and human review instructions.

confirmedSourceProperties: HTTP listener binds to 127.0.0.1, every route requires a caller-generated token of at least 32 characters, and equality uses timingSafeEqual.
Browser Origin requests are rejected; there are no CORS response headers. Client URL and model override headers/query parameters are rejected.
The service performs actual UTF-8 extraction for TXT, actual Apple Vision/PDFKit OCR for supported image/PDF paths, and labels the no-model path ocr_rules without silently claiming model inference.

The Apple path invokes LanguageModelSession/SystemLanguageModel and marks local_text_model with no image inputs and no claimed digest. The vision path explicitly attaches image inputs when available; TXT via a vision-capable model states imageCount zero and a no-image warning.

Every returned model field requires an allowed key, an existing block ID, a nonempty exact quote in every referenced block, and a value that is an exact substring of that quote. Unsupported model fields are discarded with a warning.

Input is bounded to 10MiB, three admitted/in-flight jobs, 32 retained jobs, one processing job, five PDF pages, 40 million pixels per image/page, 32000 text characters, and 1000 blocks. Model input and output have additional explicit limits/timeouts.

DELETE removes cached results and aborts queued/running jobs. A late result cannot become reachable by its removed job ID. Temporary inputs use private files under an mkdtemp service root and are normally removed in job finalization.
Citation substring validation establishes textual provenance, not correct semantic field labeling, legal effect, document authenticity, or OCR accuracy; human review remains necessary.
Re-review confirms explicit redirect rejection and fault-injection-tested cleanup recovery; all three initial findings are resolved in the frozen source hashes above.
